name: no-cache
why: no cache: the resume reads (and bills) the skips table again

name: no-prices
why: resume without the previous run's prices: the gate is priced again

name: keys-batches
why: batches of 10 keys kept: several queries (and dry runs) per table

edits.old:
batch: { by: "partition" },
  cost: FINANCE_RULE,
  price: (refs, _ctx, signal) => warehouse.dryRun("streams"
edits.new:
batch: { by: "keys", max: 10 },
  cost: FINANCE_RULE,
  price: (refs, _ctx, signal) => warehouse.dryRun("streams"

name: no-maxbytes
why: the budget never handed to the warehouse as its byte limit

name: approve-everything
why: approve cap set to Infinity: a 60 GB read is offered for approval instead of refused
